changelog.changes: Taskbar Buttons Never Combine & No Grouping Universal Enforcement (Windows 10 32/64-bit & Windows 11): 1) Fixed taskbar buttons collapsing into grouped icons ('ярлычки') by enforcing TaskbarGlomLevel=2 and MMTaskbarGlomLevel=2 across HKCU, HKLM, Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer, CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer, all loaded user profiles in HKEY_USERS (S-1-5-21-*), and C:\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT template; 2) Enforced system-wide NoTaskGrouping=1 Group Policy preventing taskbar items from ever grouping; 3) Replaced fragile cmd.exe quote-escaped registry calls with robust native PowerShell .NET registry cmdlets; 4) Enhanced CMD elevation header with 32-bit and 64-bit safe unconditional reg add commands for immediate ungrouping at launcher start; 5) Multi-stage Explorer shell lifecycle: pre-restart sweep, mid-restart enforcement while Explorer is terminated, and post-restart sweep; 6) Embedded persistent logon hook GIN-NeverCombineTaskbar in Run keys; delivered GIN-Win-Optimizer_v052.cmd.

Task View Universal Multi-Profile Suppression, Taskbar Button Ungrouping & Classic Windows 7 Blue Theme: 1) Fixed elevated execution flaw where ShowTaskViewButton and TaskbarGlomLevel were only applied to Administrator HKCU, causing Task View button to appear and taskbar buttons to group on Explorer restart; 2) Implemented global Apply-TaskbarPreferences routine enforcing ShowTaskViewButton=0, TaskbarGlomLevel=2 (Never combine buttons / wide window titles) and MMTaskbarGlomLevel=2 across HKLM (64/32), HKCU, all loaded user profiles in HKEY_USERS (S-1-5-21-*), and C:\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT template; 3) Integrated authentic Windows 7 Blue theme (Apply-Win7BlueTheme) featuring Aero Sky Blue accent (#1964BA, AccentColor=4290405401, ColorizationColor=3289998522), Light App background (AppsUseLightTheme=1) and Dark System surfaces with Start/Taskbar/Titlebars colorization; 4) Injected immediate Task View suppression, ungrouping, and Win7 theme keys into CMD polyglot elevation header; 5) Re-asserted preferences in post-restart Explorer sweep; delivered GIN-Win-Optimizer_v051.cmd.

Universal System Tray Unhiding & Multi-User Icon Promotion (chk_ui_show_all_tray_icons): 1) Fixed critical elevated execution flaw where NotifyIconSettings was only promoted in Administrator HKCU instead of interactive user hives; 2) Implemented global Promote-AllTrayIcons routine propagating IsPromoted=1 across all loaded user profiles in HKEY_USERS (S-1-5-21-*) and C:\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT template; 3) Set machine-wide NoAutoTray=1 and EnableAutoTray=0 across HKLM and HKCU to eradicate chevron auto-hiding on Windows 10 & 11; 4) Added immediate tray unhiding keys to CMD polyglot elevation header; 5) Embedded persistent startup hook in HKLM Run to automatically promote newly spawned tray icons on user logon; 6) Re-asserted promotion in post-restart Explorer sweep; delivered GIN-Win-Optimizer_v050.cmd.

Windows 11 Taskbar Search Box/Pill Complete Suppression: 1) Enforced SearchOnTaskbarMode=0 in HKLM and HKCU Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search (remedying misnamed policy); 2) Added immediate Taskbar Search suppression to CMD polyglot elevation header; 3) Integrated autonomous Taskbar Search suppression into startup SELF-HEALING & ENVIRONMENT CLEANUP routine; 4) Enhanced chk_ui_hide_search module to propagate SearchOnTaskbarMode and SearchboxTaskbarMode across 64-bit/32-bit native reg, all loaded user profiles in HKEY_USERS, and C:\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT template; 5) Re-asserted Search suppression in post-restart sweep to prevent Explorer shell reset from displaying search pill; delivered GIN-Win-Optimizer_v049.cmd.

Windows Defender High-Performance Exclusions: 1) Added chk_sec_defender_exclusions to grpSecurity; 2) Configured trusted network shares (\\s.gincz.com\soft, \\s.gincz.com\user, \\s.gincz.com\Storage, \\p.gincz.com\soft, \\152.53.182.222\soft, \\152.53.182.222\storage) preventing SMB/VPN file transfer hangs; 3) Configured local admin & dev paths (D:\UTIL, C:\UTIL, D:\AI, D:\MEGA, C:\GIN-Agent, C:\GIN-Agent-PC); 4) Configured high-I/O processes (git.exe, MEGAsync.exe) eliminating MsMpEng CPU spikes during file sync and git commands; 5) Total optimization modules expanded to 115; delivered GIN-Win-Optimizer_v048.cmd to D:\MEGA\DOCS\desktop.

OEM & Driver Bloatware Purge: 1) Added chk_ctx_intel_graphics to remove Intel Graphics context menu handlers (igfxDTCM, igfxCUI), disable rotation hotkeys (Ctrl+Alt+Arrows) and tray icon; 2) Added chk_srv_oem_lenovo to detect non-Lenovo hardware and completely delete Lenovo ImController bloat, services (ImControllerService), and C:\Windows\Lenovo folder (or disable background drain on Lenovo devices); 3) Added chk_srv_intel_graphics to disable igfxCUIService, LMS, and background modules; 4) Added chk_srv_conexant_audio to stop and disable all Cx* audio services (CxAudioSvc, CxUIUSvc, CxUtilSvc) eliminating CPU load; 5) Total optimization modules expanded to 114; delivered GIN-Win-Optimizer_v047.cmd to D:\MEGA\DOCS\desktop.

Console Log Terminal & Status Completion Highlighting: Upgraded txtConsoleLog to RichTextBox with zero-margin FlowDocument styling; applied vibrant bold yellow/gold (#facc15) highlight to completion banner ('ALL OPTIMIZATION OPERATIONS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETED!') and bottom status bar (txtStatus); added backwards-compatible dynamic .Text ScriptProperty and safe methods for Clear, Copy, and Export; delivered GIN-Win-Optimizer_v046.cmd to D:\MEGA\DOCS\desktop.

Comprehensive Total Zero-UAC Enforcement: 1) Hardcoded immediate reg add at CMD launcher elevation to disable UAC permanently in registry (EnableLUA=0, ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=0, ConsentPromptBehaviorUser=0, PromptOnSecureDesktop=0, FilterAdministratorToken=0, EnableInstallerDetection=0, ValidateAdminCodeSignatures=0); 2) Updated taskMap['chk_sec_uac_quiet'] to enforce EnableLUA=0 and all zero-prompt keys on optimization; 3) Replaced destructive New-Item -Force on Policies\System with safe non-destructive checks; 4) Updated EN/RU/CS localization to 'Total Zero-UAC (EnableLUA=0)'; 5) Synced directly to D:\MEGA\DOCS\desktop\GIN-Win-Optimizer_v045.cmd.

Critical CMD Launcher Header Restoration: Fixed corrupted cmd polyglot header that contained stray duplicate comment closers and escaped variables preventing execution on Windows 10; completely purged accidental batch header remnants from pure PowerShell engine.ps1; verified clean execution via both non-elevated double-click auto-elevation and direct 'Run as Administrator'; synchronized to D:\MEGA\DOCS\desktop\GIN-Win-Optimizer_v044.cmd.
